newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko Sec sees TSE stock volume leveling off.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Sec sees TSE stock volume leveling off.

text.p: Nikko Securities Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it expects the daily average turnover on the Tokyo Stock Exchange to be about 450 billion yen in the second half of fiscal 1996/97 to next March.
A senior company official told a news conference, "We see turnover leveling (in the second half) ... We don't think the estimate is too optimistic."
Nikko earlier today revised its earnings forecast for 1996/97 downward. It now sees it parent current profit at 60 billion yen from the previous forecast of 85 billion yen.
Nikko Securities also revised its parent current profit for the first half to September 30 to 20 billion yen from the previous forecast of 38 billion yen.

The official said that the average daily turnover at the Tokyo exchange was 430.5 billion yen for the first five months of 1996/97, compared with its previous assumption that the turnover would be 500 billion yen in the first half.
Because of the lower volume, commission from the stockbroking business is expected to fall to 44 billion yen in the first half from the previous forecast of 61 billion.
